01.title: 01. Stealth Dart Fighter
stepHints: Fold the two top corners down so the top edges meet the center line.
Fold the new slanted edges to the center line again.
Fold the plane in half backward along the center line.
Fold each wing down so its top edge lines up with the bottom of the plane.
Open the wings so they stand level. Ready to fly!

02.title: 02. Valkyrie Arrow Jet
stepHints: Fold the two top corners down so the top edges meet the center line.
Fold the new slanted edges to the center line.
Fold the slanted edges to the center line one more time for a needle nose.
Fold the plane in half backward along the center line.
Fold each wing down along the wing line, one to the front and one to the back.
Open the wings so they stand level. Ready to fly!

03.title: 03. Orbital Space Shuttle
stepHints: Fold the two top corners down so the top edges meet the center line.
Fold the top point down to make a blunt nose.
Fold the slanted edges to the center line.
Fold the plane in half backward along the center line.
Fold each wing down along the wing line, one to the front and one to the back.
Open the wings so they stand level. Ready to fly!

04.title: 04. Neon Panther Mask
stepHints: Turn the square so a corner points up.
Fold the top corner down to the bottom corner.
Fold the side corners up to make pointy ears.
Fold the bottom point up a little for the chin.
Turn it over. Your panther mask is ready!

05.title: 05. Baby Dragon Head
stepHints: Turn the square so a corner points up.
Fold the top corner down to the bottom corner.
Fold the side corners up and out to make horns.
Fold the bottom point up for the snout.
Turn it over and meet your baby dragon!

06.title: 06. Kitsune Fox Mask
stepHints: Turn the square so a corner points up.
Fold the top corner down to the bottom corner.
Fold the side corners down to the bottom point.
Fold the two points up and out to make the fox ears.

07.title: 07. Bulldog Interceptor
stepHints: Fold the two top corners down so the top edges meet the center line.
Fold the top point down to the bottom of the flaps.
Fold the new top corners to the center line.
Fold the plane in half backward along the center line.
Fold each wing down along the wing line, one to the front and one to the back.
Open the wings so they stand level. Ready to fly!

08.title: 08. Delta Wing Raider
stepHints: Turn the square so a corner points up.
Fold the two upper edges to the center line (kite fold).
Fold the plane in half backward along the center line.
Fold each wing down along the wing line, one to the front and one to the back.
Open the wings so they stand level. Ready to fly!

09.title: 09. B-2 Flying Wing
stepHints: Fold the top edge down a little.
Roll it down again.
Roll it down one more time to make a heavy leading edge.
Fold the plane in half backward along the center line.
Fold each wing down along the wing line, one to the front and one to the back.
Open the wings so they stand level. Ready to fly!

10.title: 10. Caucasian Golden Ram
stepHints: Turn the square so a corner points up.
Fold the top corner down to the bottom corner.
Fold the side corners down to make the curled horns.
Fold the tips of the horns behind to curl them.
Fold the bottom point up for the nose. The golden ram is ready!

11.title: 11. Dragon's Goblet
stepHints: Turn the square so a corner points up.
Fold the bottom corner up to the top corner.
Fold the left corner across so its top edge lies flat.
Fold the right corner across the same way.
Fold the top flaps down, one to the front and one to the back. Cheers!

12.title: 12. Sky Manta Glider
stepHints: Turn the square so a corner points up.
Fold the bottom corner up to the top corner.
Fold the top point down to the bottom edge.
Fold the plane in half backward along the center line.
Fold each wing down along the wing line, one to the front and one to the back.
Open the wings so they stand level. Ready to fly!

13.title: 13. Pterodactyl Glider
stepHints: Turn the square so a corner points up.
Fold the two upper edges to the center line (kite fold).
Fold the top point down to make a blunt beak.
Fold the plane in half backward along the center line.
Fold each wing down along the wing line, one to the front and one to the back.
Open the wings so they stand level. Ready to fly!

14.title: 14. Hammer-Nose Raptor
stepHints: Fold the top edge down to the middle of the sheet.
Fold the new top corners to the center line.
Fold the plane in half backward along the center line.
Fold each wing down along the wing line, one to the front and one to the back.
Open the wings so they stand level. Ready to fly!

15.title: 15. Dragon Oracle Fortune Teller
stepHints: Fold all four corners to the center.
Turn it over.
Fold all four new corners to the center again.
Fold it in half.
Unfold it, push the corners together and slide your fingers into the pockets!

16.title: 16. Sea Leviathan
stepHints: Turn the square so a corner points up.
Fold the two lower edges to the center line (kite fold).
Fold the top point down to make the head.
Fold the plane in half backward along the center line.
Fold the tail up.
Turn the leviathan on its side. It's ready to swim!

17.title: 17. Star-Cruiser Dreadnought
stepHints: Fold the two top corners down so the top edges meet the center line.
Fold the top point down so it reaches past the middle.
Fold the top corners in so they meet at the center line just above the little point.
Fold the little point up over the corners to lock them.
Fold the plane in half backward along the center line.
Fold each wing down along the wing line, one to the front and one to the back.
Open the wings so they stand level. Ready to fly!

18.title: 18. Dragon Knight Helmet
stepHints: Turn the square so a corner points up.
Fold the top corner down to the bottom corner.
Fold the side corners down to the bottom point.
Fold the points of those flaps up to the top.
Fold the points out to the sides to make horns.
Fold the front bottom point up.
Fold it up again along the bottom of the horns to make the brim.
Fold the back bottom point up behind. Your dragon knight helmet is done!
